description: Prepares an HTTPS source, opens a bounded research session and queues a source_inspect probe. Supply rights_claim.claim_note with the actual rights evidence or operator assertion; the service hashes its trimmed UTF-8 bytes and returns rights_claim with the real digest. Alternatively supply an already computed claim_evidence_digest; never fabricate a hash. A digest records the claim, not legal verification. Returns session_id, probe_id, source_id, question_id, rights_claim and limits; it does not write a recipe. To ask the prepared source more (sample rows, profile columns, evaluate an aggregate), call probe_source with its dataset_id, question_id and source_id. If uncertain, preserve the coordinates and call get_source_inspection; this tool never retries preparation. For an archive (ZIP) address, pass archive_members: true: the inspection lists the archive's member names, so you can pick one and write an archive.zip recipe whose member is that exact name. A refusal RANGED_READ_UNSUPPORTED means the host cannot serve byte ranges — choose another mirror or ask the person for one; ARCHIVE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED means the file is not a ZIP; ARCHIVE_DIRECTORY_LIMIT means its directory is too large to list; ARCHIVE_MEMBERS_UNAVAILABLE means this deployment has not enabled archive member listing, and every other inspection works as before.
name: start_source_inspection
title: Start a bounded source inspection
